sources.review_notes: All 9 pages reviewed against page renders by one reviewer agent (report: reports/review-pages-0001-0009.md): two-column reading order rebuilt around floats, Fig. 3 re-boxed and the paragraph it had swallowed restored, 9 figures, 6 tables and Algorithm 1 checked by crops, all display equations (optimal-control problem, (1), (2), (3a)-(3f), (4)-(10)) transcribed from the authors' TeX and compared with high-resolution crops, 46 references checked. Verifier diagnostics on pages 2-5 and 7-9 are LaTeX-notation differences, the Algorithm 1 transcription and rejoined arXiv identifiers, adjudicated per page.
